source: MAFF / ADB, "សណ្តែកបាយ" [Bean crop — mung bean and black gram], official cultivation manual, 2005 (black gram sections)
text: Harvest guidance parallels mung bean's (picking/cutting once the majority of pods reach mature brown/black color, drying to safe storage moisture). The manual reports black gram yield data from Cambodian conditions in the range of roughly 500–1,400 kg/ha, with an average cited around 700–1,000 kg/ha depending on variety and management level described in the source.
